run_GTestXMLOutputUnitTest: run the GTestXMLOutputUnitTest suite to verify Google Test XML output generation
test_non_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest binary produces the expected non-empty XML output with test results
test_empty_xml_output: test that a gtest binary with no tests produces an empty XML output document
test_filtered_test_xml_output: test XML output when a gtest filter flag restricts which tests execute
test_sharded_test_xml_output: test XML output when gtest runs with sharding environment variables set
